evals.prompt: Prepare the shared team-meeting briefing for Sample Team specialists from reports/sample-team/series.json at 2026-10-26T09:00:00+00:00. Use the project-level signals configuration and this series' local evidence. Standing practices and narratives are already approved. Do not access real connectors, the network or files outside this workspace. Do not ask questions. Write reports/sample-team/2026-10-26-0900/report.md and preserve evidence/configuration provenance in that instance. If your chosen workflow needs support documents, use the support-document map in its package; source content is local. If a supporting utility is unavailable, document the check as not run and complete the briefing using the local source files.

News opens with a bulleted index and matching detail subsections; Reminders separates general actions and the agenda has matching detail for every summary item. Acknowledgements and Reminders agenda details are direct item lists rather than decision-topic briefing labels.

evals.prompt: Revise only the Q4 business-context excerpt using inputs/comparable.json. Write outputs/analysis.md. assertions.text: All three configured views show source-matched quota/booked actual/attainment:100/75/75%,200/160/80% and80/100/125%.
Remaining gap means quota minus booked actual:25,40 and−20millionUSD; above-quota performance has a negative remaining gap.
The quota view precedes all four original finer rows, retaining booked values75,65,20 and100millionUSD.
Product A overlap with Combined View is explained and overlapping views are not added into a team total or combined attainment.
The weighted forecast300 is not substituted for booked actual or used in attainment.
Region A product overlay,2026-Q4,Booked value,standard-rate USDmillions and quarter-to-date actuals against full-quarter quota remain explicit.

contract_scenarios: Add configured quota attainment without losing product detail

evals.name: gws-unavailable
evals.prompt: Prepare a source coverage note for a team meeting configured to use Gmail, Google Calendar and a linked Google Slides deck. The global GWS CLI still returns an authentication error after permitted host access is tried. Other non-Google sources are available. Do not access live services or a browser in this eval. State how collection proceeds and which sources count as reviewed. Write outputs/coverage.md.
evals.expected_output: Use the global GWS workflow for Google Workspace sources. Mark the Gmail, Calendar and Slides sources unavailable after the authentication failure, explain the access problem and continue with other sources. Do not claim to have reviewed them through a browser or screen scrape.

assertions.text: The response names the global GWS workflow as the retrieval path for Gmail, Calendar and Slides.
All three Google sources remain unavailable after the CLI authentication error; the response neither claims they were reviewed nor substitutes browser screen scraping.
The response continues with available non-Google evidence and discloses the Google coverage gap.

contract_scenarios: Retrieve Google Workspace signals through GWS
